description: List what needs the customer across their open bookings, one entry per action: choose_interpreter (interpreters responded as available; next tolk2go_interpreting_get_responses and tolk2go_interpreting_preview_selection), pay (give the customer payment_url) or review_extra_cost (the interpreter proposed an extra cost; the customer accepts or declines it from the Tolk2Go email or app). An empty list means nothing waits on the customer. A change the customer requested waits on the interpreter and is not listed.
name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_pending_actions
title: List actions waiting on the customer
